blocks.text: In Cantonese cuisine, the quality of the ingredients matters as much as the skill that goes into preparing them. At Crystal Dragon, the fine-dining Chinese restaurant at City of Dreams Manila, this philosophy takes shape in a refreshed a la carte menu that brings time-honored specialties together with new culinary creations. Known for its refined approach to Chinese cuisine, the restaurant strikes a balance between tradition and innovation, allowing premium ingredients and meticulous preparation to take center stage. But the experience extends beyond the plate. Crystal Dragon’s elegant ambience, enhanced by new carpeting and updated tableware, adds another layer of sophistication, […]...
